content: Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of selpercatinib by influencing hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzyme metabolism. It is recommended to avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of selumetinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or consider an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of sildenafil by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Potent CYP3A4 inducers can significantly lower sildenafil plasma levels. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of silodosin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of simvastatin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of siponimod by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Coadministration with moderate CYP2C9 and strong CYP3A4 inducers is not recommended, especially in patients with CYP2C9 1/3 or 2/3 genotypes. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of sirolimus by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Nafcillin increases the levels or effects of sofosbuvir/velpatasvir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Velpatasvir is metabolized by CYP2B6, CYP2C8, and CYP3A4, and moderate-to-potent inducers of these enzymes may significantly reduce its plasma concentrations, potentially reducing therapeutic efficacy. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of sonidegib by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Avoid combining sonidegib with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of sotorasib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of stiripentol by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers cannot be avoided, consider increasing the stiripentol dose. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of tazemetostat by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Tetracycline reduces the effects of nafcillin through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of tezacaftor by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of tivozanib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of tolvaptan by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of trabectedin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of tucatinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the efficacy of the live typhoid vaccine through pharmacodynamic antagonism. This combination is contraindicated. Wait until antibiotic therapy is complete before administering live bacterial vaccines. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of ubrogepant by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of upadacitinib by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Avoid combining upadacitinib with strong CYP3A4 inducers. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of velpatasvir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of venetoclax by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Avoid combining venetoclax with strong or moderate CYP3A inducers. Consider alternative treatments with less CYP3A induction. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of voclosporin by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of vonoprazan by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels of vorapaxar by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of voxilaprevir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of zanubrutinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, increase the zanubrutinib dose to 320 mg twice daily. After discontinuing the CYP3A4 inducer, resume the previous zanubrutinib dose. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of zuranolone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Nafcillin decreases the levels of abiraterone by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Avoid combining abiraterone with strong CYP3A4 inducers. If a strong inducer must be used, increase the abiraterone dosage frequency from once daily to twice daily. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of acalabrutinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin and aspirin may increase each other's levels through plasma protein binding competition or by decreasing renal clearance. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the effects of atezolizumab through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration may interfere with the therapeutic effects of immune checkpoint inhibitors. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of atogepant by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. The recommended atogepant dosage with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers is 30 mg or 60 mg daily. Nafcillin decreases the effects of avelumab through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration may interfere with the therapeutic effects of immune checkpoint inhibitors. Nafcillin reduces the effects of balstilimab through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration may interfere with the therapeutic effects of immune checkpoint inhibitors. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of bazedoxifene/conjugated estrogens by altering intestinal flora. This applies only to oral forms of the hormone and carries a low risk of contraceptive failure. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of belumosudil by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Increase the belumosudil dosage to 200 mg twice daily when coadministered with strong CYP3A inducers. Nafcillin and bendroflumethiazide may increase each other's levels by decreasing renal clearance. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of benzhydrocodone/acetaminophen by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Caution is advised when discontinuing CYP3A4 inducers coadministered with benzhydrocodone, as plasma hydrocodone concentrations may increase, potentially causing fatal respiratory depression. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of brexpiprazole by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Double the brexpiprazole dose over 1–2 weeks if coadministered with a strong CYP3A4 inducer. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of bromocriptine by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of budesonide by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of buprenorphine (including buccal, subdermal implant, transdermal, and long-acting injection forms) by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. For subdermal implants, monitor for withdrawal symptoms, and consider implant removal if necessary. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of cabazitaxel by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inducers. Nafcillin reduces the levels of calcifediol by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Drugs that stimulate microsomal hydroxylation reduce calcifediol's half-life. Nafcillin decreases the effects of camrelizumab through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration may interfere with the therapeutic effects of immune checkpoint inhibitors. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of cannabidiol by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Consider increasing the cannabidiol dosage based on clinical response and tolerability when coadministered with a strong CYP3A4 inducer. Nafcillin decreases the effects of cemiplimab through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration may interfere with the therapeutic effects of immune checkpoint inhibitors. Chloramphenicol reduces the effects of nafcillin through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Use caution and monitor closely. Bacteriostatic antibiotics may interfere with the bactericidal actions of penicillins. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of chlordiazepoxide by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin and choline magnesium trisalicylate may increase each other's levels through plasma protein binding competition or by decreasing renal clearance. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of citalopram by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of clonazepam by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of clorazepate by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of conjugated estrogens (vaginal) by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the effects of cosibelimab through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration may interfere with the therapeutic effects of immune checkpoint inhibitors. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of crizotinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of cyclosporine by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of dantrolene by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of darifenacin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Strong CYP3A4 inducers may increase the metabolism of CYP3A4 substrates. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of darunavir by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin and deflazacort both decrease serum potassium levels. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of diazepam (buccal and intranasal forms) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers may increase the rate of diazepam elimination, reducing its efficacy. Nafcillin increases the levels or effects of digoxin by altering intestinal flora. This applies only to oral forms of both agents. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of diltiazem by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the effects of dostarlimab through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration may interfere with the therapeutic effects of immune checkpoint inhibitors. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of doxorubicin (including liposomal forms) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Strong CYP3A4 inducers may increase the metabolism of CYP3A4 substrates. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of dronabinol by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Dronabinol is a CYP3A4 substrate. Nafcillin decreases the effects of durvalumab through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration may interfere with the therapeutic effects of immune checkpoint inhibitors. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of efavirenz by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Strong CYP3A4 inducers may increase the metabolism of CYP3A4 substrates. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of elagolix by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of enzalutamide by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of erlotinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of escitalopram by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of estradiol by altering intestinal flora. This applies only to oral forms of the hormone and carries a low risk of contraceptive failure. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of estrogens (conjugated synthetic, esterified, and estradiol vaginal) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of eszopiclone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of ethinyl estradiol by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of ethosuximide by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of etoposide by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of etravirine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of exemestane by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of felbamate by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of fentanyl (including intranasal, transdermal, and transmucosal forms) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Coadministration with CYP3A4 inducers may decrease fentanyl plasma concentrations, leading to reduced efficacy or withdrawal symptoms in dependent patients. After stopping a CYP3A4 inducer, fentanyl plasma concentrations may increase, potentially prolonging therapeutic and adverse effects. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of fesoterodine by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of flibanserin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of flurazepam by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of fosamprenavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of gefitinib by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Increase gefitinib to 500 mg daily if coadministered with a strong CYP3A4 inducer. Resume the standard dose of 250 mg/day seven days after discontinuing the inducer. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of glecaprevir/pibrentasvir by altering CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration with CYP3A4 inducers may decrease plasma concentrations, potentially reducing therapeutic efficacy. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of guanfacine by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers significantly reduce guanfacine plasma concentrations and elimination half-life. For ADHD patients, consider doubling the recommended dose of extended-release guanfacine. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of haloperidol by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin and hydrochlorothiazide may increase each other's levels by decreasing renal clearance. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of hydrocodone by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy or monitor closely. Caution is advised when discontinuing CYP3A4 inducers coadministered with hydrocodone, as plasma concentrations may increase, potentially causing fatal respiratory depression. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of hydroxyprogesterone caproate by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin and IV ibuprofen may increase each other's levels through plasma protein binding competition or by decreasing renal clearance. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin increases the toxicity of ifosfamide by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. CYP3A4 inducers may increase the formation of neurotoxic/nephrotoxic ifosfamide metabolites. Monitor for toxicities and consider dose adjustments. Nafcillin and indapamide may increase each other's levels by decreasing renal clearance. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin reduces the levels or effects of indinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Nafcillin decreases the levels or effects of isosorbide dinitrate by influencing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely.
